about: M30 recall benchmark: 80 facts (60 English, 20 Hebrew) and 48 queries. Each query expects one fact. Categories: keyword, paraphrase, synonym, crosslingual (Hebrew↔English), typo, distractor (a wrong fact shares the query's words).
